sql: SELECT name FROM enlist WHERE name IN (SELECT name FROM enrolled GROUP BY name HAVING COUNT(school) = 2) GROUP BY name HAVING COUNT(organ) = 2
SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(month = 0, 1, 0)) - SUM(IIF(month = 9, 1, 0)) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(IIF(month = 0, 1, 0)) FROM longest_absense_from_school

SELECT T1.name FROM male AS T1 INNER JOIN unemployed AS T2 ON T1.name = T2.name INNER JOIN disabled AS T3 ON T1.name = T3.name INNER JOIN longest_absense_from_school AS T4 ON T1.name = T4.name WHERE T4.month = 5
SELECT SUM(IIF(T2.name IS NOT NULL, 1, 0)) - SUM(IIF(T2.name IS NULL, 1, 0)) FROM filed_for_bankrupcy AS T1 LEFT JOIN male AS T2 ON T1.name = T2.name
SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T2.name IS NOT NULL, 1, 0)) - SUM(IIF(T2.name IS NULL, 1, 0)) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.name) FROM longest_absense_from_school AS T1 LEFT JOIN disabled AS T2 ON T1.name = T2.name

SELECT CAST(COUNT(T4.name) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.name) FROM person AS T1 INNER JOIN enlist AS T2 ON T1.name = T2.name INNER JOIN enrolled AS T3 ON T1.name = T3.name LEFT JOIN male AS T4 ON T1.name = T4.name WHERE T2.organ = 'air_force' AND T3.school = 'ucla'

SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.school = 'uci' AND T3.name IS NULL, 1, 0)) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.name) FROM enrolled AS T1 INNER JOIN disabled AS T2 ON T1.name = T2.name LEFT JOIN male AS T3 ON T1.name = T3.name
